plan: My private value is $10. In a second-price sealed bid auction, optimal strategy is typically to bid close to my true value. Since the prize is randomly valued between $0-$49, other bidders might have higher or lower values. I'll bid slightly above my true value to increase winning chances while protecting against overpaying. A bid of $11 ensures I win if others bid below my value, and limits potential loss if I win.
